entries.title: 얇은 금속 · 색 대비
entries.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished raster game UI design proposal, concept 01 "얇은 금속 · 색 대비", for RuneNexus turret UPGRADE and SELL controls. Reference image is STYLE AND CONTEXT ONLY: current actual mobile game screenshot. Its tiny low-contrast upgrade/sell controls are the PROBLEM. Produce a single landscape design presentation focused on an enlarged bottom turret-panel header, NOT a full phone screen. Show ONE proposed pair of upgrade and sell controls, in a believable compact horizontal turret action strip with '기관총' and 'Lv.7' at left and small '특성' rune action at right. Below, retain subtle connected '스탯' and '젬 링크' tabs for in-game context. Render the narrow HUD at 3x presentation scale so it is clear, keeping plausible mobile proportions. Background dark ink-teal, sophisticated fantasy-industrial metal/rune game aesthetic consistent with reference. Exact upgrade text '강화' and '204 G'; exact sell text '판매' and '+45 G'. Spend versus receive clearly distinguished. Icons must be immediately recognizable at small size, text high-contrast and large enough, not tiny or blurry. Thin frames only; avoid generic flat web buttons, chunky stone, ornate heavy borders, excessive bloom and overdecoration. Specific distinct design: Two thin chamfered silver-metal plaques, luminous TEAL filled upgrade surface and muted warm BRONZE sell surface. Large simple up-chevron over a turret on upgrade; coin and outward arrow on sell. Thin restrained metal edges, strong internal fill contrast. Put small editorial concept number '01' and short Korean heading '얇은 금속 · 색 대비' ABOVE the UI, outside the game panel. This is a concept presentation only, not final sliced assets. Clean meticulous high fidelity game UI, no extra explanatory copy, no checkmarks.
